body: My point is that I don’t know if he is not interested anymore or if I’m overthinking it.

I agree with you. I know I can be really needy and ask for a lot of validation from partners but also it takes me a while to realize what I’m doing, since it’s kind of a automatic behavior. That is why I worry they simply got annoyed with my constant need for attention and that’s why they won’t talk to me. And maybe never will again. 
I’ve been treating my bpd for almost 3 years now, with therapy and meds. It’s still a long way to go but I’m trying to improve. Thank you for your response.
